description: OCR scanned or image-only corpora with vision-language models, in three phases. Use `evaluate` to compare candidate OCR systems against stratified human ground truth and pick one on measured CER/WER, `run` to build the production pipeline (model selection, image handling, prompts, architecture, batching, accuracy evaluation, reproducibility), and `clean` to correct raw OCR text with LLM and rule-based passes, quality diagnostics, multilingual handling, and span-level provenance. Not for born-digital documents with a text layer — those go to $doc-to-markdown.
